Question Choices: What is a histogram?  (A) A graph that shows exact individual data values.   (B) A graph that shows how data is grouped into intervals (buckets).   (C) A graph that only shows the largest number
Hints: Distinguish an interval of values from its frequency.
Solution: A histogram divides numerical values into non-overlapping intervals (bins or buckets), then shows how many observations lie in each interval. It does not retain each exact observation.
